solutionSql:
SELECT id,
       booked_at
FROM shipments
WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 60
  AND booked_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND booked_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-02-01 00:00:00+00'
ORDER BY id;
notes: Shipments 1 and 2 are booked on 31 January, and shipments 49 to 60 on 1 January. The half-open range from 2026-01-01 UTC to 2026-02-01 UTC includes the 23:59:59.999 boundary on shipment 2, as the ticket requires.
